intro: The Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor is a confidential report penned by Warden Thelwater regarding an enigmatic man who visited the imprisoned Defias leader, Bazil Thredd, inside the Stormwind Stockade. Its contents help track down a covert operative moving unseen through Stormwind's political and criminal spheres.

p: For years inside the Stockade, prisoner Bazil Thredd sat in his cell with no visitors. That routine shifted when an uncommunicative man began stopping by once or twice a week with completely valid identification papers. Taking note of these unusual arrivals, Warden Thelwater composed a physical account of the man, who carried identification marking him as 'Maelik'. The warden sealed the profile to prevent any meddling eyes from reading it before proper investigators could act.
